test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

h _ jh _ ijhhi _ hh _ jh
solution:
Given : h _ jh _ ijhhi _ hh _ jh

By checking options :

 
• ihji → h __**i**__ jh __**h**__ ijhhi __**j**__ hh __**i**__ jh → (It follows the pattern of : hijh - hijh - hijh - hijh) 
 
• jjhi → h **__j__** jh **__j__** ijhhi __h__ hh __i__ jh → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• hiji → h __h__ jh __i__ ijhhi __j__ hh __i__ jh → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• ihhi → h __i__ jh __h__ ijhhi __h__ hh __i__ jh → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)

⇒Option - (1) gives the pattern of "h__i__jh - __h__ijh - hi__j__h - h__i__jh"

Hence, "**ihji**" is the correct answer.
